anomalies.observed: D30 pin 4 (A2) is on ESTOP_OUT, and R60 pin 2 is also on ESTOP_OUT, with R60 pin 1 on Net-(D30-K2) (= D30 pin 2, K2). The LED2 branch therefore runs from ESTOP_OUT back to ESTOP_OUT and carries no current. The mirror branch R59 is correctly returned to GND.
anomalies.expected: R60 pin 2 should return to GND, mirroring R59 for the second LED of the dual indicator, so that the ESTOP_OUT-driven LED2 has a path to ground.
anomalies.impact: The ESTOP_OUT status LED for the second dual-LED channel never lights, so the e-stop indication is incomplete. The fault is cosmetic to the control path but misleads the operator.

anomalies.observed: R36 is valued "24k", but its library description and MPN (FRC0805J240TSD, "24Ω") both describe a 24 Ω part. The value and the part identity disagree by three orders of magnitude.
anomalies.expected: The value field should match the purchased part. Either the value should read 24R or the part should be a 24k resistor.

evidence.quote: (comp (ref "R36") (value "24k") ... (description " 125mW Thick Film Resistors 150V ±100ppm/℃ ±5% 24Ω 0805 Chip Resistor - Surface Mount ROHS")

anomalies.impact: If the part is populated as a 24 Ω resistor across the high-voltage output, it loads the supply heavily and will dissipate significant power. If it is really 24 kΩ, the assembled part is wrong, and the mismatch in the BOM can lead to the wrong component being placed.

anomalies.observed: The output of U37 (74LVC1G86 XOR, pin 4 declared as output) and U14 pin 25 (~DSRA, a SC16IS752 output) share one net. Two push-pull outputs are tied together.
anomalies.expected: A single driven output per net. An XOR gate output should not be tied to a UART modem-status output.
anomalies.impact: Output contention between the XOR gate and the UART output can cause excessive current and an undefined logic level on DSRA. U37 also takes an input from the unconnected-looking HDMI1 lane (Module1 pin 154), which points to a hack or a wiring error.

parsed.summary: The most credible anomaly is the second dual-LED channel in D30, where R60 and the LED anode both sit on ESTOP_OUT, so that LED can never conduct. A value/part mismatch on R36 and an output-to-output contention on Net-(U37-Pad4) are weaker candidates; the rest of the netlist and SPICE deck look consistent with the spec.
